sensor: 1/3" Panasonic MN34229 CMOS (1080p, Wide Dynamic Range)

power.method: DC power adapter (WiFi variant; the IN-9020 is the PoE equivalent)

storage.notes: Ships with a 16GB microSD card installed. Also supports FTP upload and the optional INSTAR Cloud.

features: WiFi variant of the IN-9020 (PoE); same Panasonic 1080p WDR sensor
integrated microphone plus 3.5mm audio-out jack for an external speaker
PIR heat sensor plus software motion detection

frigate.notes: INSTAR Full HD generation uses a simple numbered RTSP path (/11 main, /12/13 sub) rather than the '/livestream/NN' pattern of the newer 2K+/4K line. Exact substream numbering not independently confirmed; ONVIF was not documented for this legacy model (RTSP confirmed).

home_assistant.notes: ONVIF unconfirmed; generic RTSP/MJPEG integration recommended. MQTT is a documented alternative.

blue_iris.notes: Not independently confirmed for this specific model.
